requirement.description: RLP encoding/decoding functions are missing required dependencies (rlp package) causing test failures. Tests requiring rlp decoding fail with ImportError.
requirement.contract: Fix the rlp_decode function to handle missing rlp package gracefully by implementing fallback logic or improving error messages. The function should work with or without the rlp package installed, or provide clear installation instructions.

requirement.description: RLP encoding functions are not correctly handling certain data types and edge cases, causing test failures.
requirement.contract: Improve the rlp_encode function to correctly handle various input types (strings, integers, lists) and ensure proper RLP encoding according to Ethereum specifications. Fix the logic for handling address/nonce tuples and ensure correct hex string processing.

requirement.description: Cryptographic functions are missing required dependencies (ecdsa and hashlib packages) causing test failures.
requirement.contract: Ensure cryptographic functions (private_key_to_public_key, private_key_to_address, sign_message_hash, get_signer_public_key) properly check for and handle missing dependencies with clear error messages. The functions should either implement fallback logic or provide informative error messages instructing users to install required packages.

requirement.description: CREATE2 address calculation is failing due to improper handling of data types and keccak hash computation.
requirement.contract: Fix the get_created_address function to properly handle CREATE2 address calculations by ensuring correct data formatting and keccak hash computation. The function should properly handle hex string inputs and ensure the RLP encoding process produces correct results.

requirement.description: Code compliance tests are failing because several files are missing the required future annotations import.
requirement.contract: Add the required 'from __future__ import annotations' import to all Python files in the codebase to ensure compatibility with modern Python features and type checking.
